entities.name: Tracking Area Update procedure
entities.description: Procedure for updating tracking area and location area information between UE and network.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message
entities.description: Network response message in tracking area update procedure.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message
entities.description: UE response message sent to complete tracking area update procedure.

entities.name: EPS update result IE
entities.description: Information element indicating the result of EPS update procedure.

entities.name: Combined TA/LA updated condition
entities.description: Condition when EPS update result IE indicates successful tracking and location area updating for EPS and non-EPS services.

entities.name: TA updated condition
entities.description: Condition when EPS update result IE indicates successful tracking area updating but unsuccessful location area updating.

entities.name: GUTI or TMSI present condition
entities.description: Condition when TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message contains GUTI or TMSI or both.

entities.name: GUTI
entities.description: Globally Unique Temporary Identity used to identify the UE.

entities.name: TMSI
entities.description: Temporary Mobile Subscriber Identity used to identify the UE.

relations.description: TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message contains the EPS update result IE.
EPS update result IE value guards the condition for combined TA/LA update.
EPS update result IE value guards the condition for TA update only.
Presence of GUTI or TMSI in TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT guards the condition for sending TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message may contain GUTI.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message may contain TMSI.
Condition of GUTI or TMSI presence establishes the requirement to send TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message.
